lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co2SiAs crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a cell formula Co8Si4As4, 16 atoms in the unit cell, and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As centers with 10 neighbors (3 Co, 7 Si), Co centers with 14 neighbors (5 As, 2 Co, 7 Si), and Si centers with 6 neighbors (5 Co, 1 Si). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face sharing between As and Co polyhedra, and corner sharing between As and Si polyhedra.
